description: This file contains the styling rules for the Tic Tac Toe frontend application, including the layout, colors, and responsive design for various components.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main application container which centers content and sets a background color.

classes.name: game-container
classes.description: Styles for the game container that sets maximum width and padding.

classes.name: game-status
classes.description: Styles for displaying the game status, including margins and text color.

classes.description: Layout styles for the game board using CSS Grid.
